skills.name: nostr-auth
skills.description: Authenticate to Nostria HTTP APIs with NIP-98. Use when calling api.nostria.app or signing Nostr HTTP auth events.

skills.name: nostria-urls
skills.description: Canonical Nostria URL patterns for profiles, posts, articles, search, and NIP-05 names. Use when linking to Nostria content.

skills.name: nostria-mcp
skills.description: Call the public Nostria MCP server over Streamable HTTP. Use for NIP-05 lookup, public accounts, and canonical URL helpers.
